examples.japanese: {舅|しゅうと}は{去年|きょねん}{亡|な}くなった。
examples.english: My father-in-law passed away last year.

examples.japanese: {舅|しゅうと}との{関係|かんけい}は{良好|りょうこう}だ。
examples.english: I have a good relationship with my father-in-law.

examples.japanese: {舅|しゅうと}と{姑|しゅうとめ}に{挨拶|あいさつ}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to greet my father-in-law and mother-in-law.

notes:
USAGE NOTES:
- {舅|しゅうと} refers specifically to the father of one's spouse.
- The kanji is rarely used; often written in hiragana.
- In formal contexts, {義父|ぎふ} or {義理|ぎり}の{父|ちち} may be used.

RELATED TERMS:
- {姑|しゅうとめ} (mother-in-law)
- {義父|ぎふ} (father-in-law, formal)
- {義理|ぎり}の{両親|りょうしん} (parents-in-law)
